# Packages
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("00_requirements.R")
source("04_Functions.R")
```

# Load Cleaned Datasets
```{r load-data}
load("Output/cleaned_data.RData")
head(monthly_combined)
dim(monthly_combined)
```

# monthly returns
```{r monthly-returns}
monthly_returns <- calculate_monthly_returns(monthly_combined)
head(monthly_returns)
```
# calculate monthly volatility
```{r}
monthly_volatility <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),
  Monthly_Volatility = c(
    sd(monthly_returns$Bitcoin_Return),
    sd(monthly_returns$SP500_Return),
    sd(monthly_returns$IEF_Return)
  )
)
print(monthly_volatility)
```

# cumulative returns
```{r cumulative-returns}
cumulative_returns <- calculate_cumulative_returns(monthly_returns)
head(cumulative_returns)
```

# calculate initial $1,000 investment
```{r lump-sum-investment}
initial_investment <- 1000

lump_sum_results <- calculate_lump_sum(
  cumulative_returns,
  initial_investment
)
head(lump_sum_results)
```

# calculate monthly investment performance
```{r performance-summary}
performance_summary <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),
  Average_Monthly_Return = c(
    mean(monthly_returns$Bitcoin_Return),
    mean(monthly_returns$SP500_Return),
    mean(monthly_returns$IEF_Return)
  ),
  Monthly_Volatility = c(
    sd(monthly_returns$Bitcoin_Return),
    sd(monthly_returns$SP500_Return),
    sd(monthly_returns$IEF_Return)
  )
)
print(performance_summary)
```
# Examine final investment
```{r final-investment-values}
final_investment_values <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),
  Final_Value = c(
    tail(lump_sum_results$Bitcoin_Value, 1),
    tail(lump_sum_results$SP500_Value, 1),
    tail(lump_sum_results$IEF_Value, 1)
  )
)
print(final_investment_values)
```

# Calculate Monthly Investment Performance
```{r monthly-investment}
monthly_investment_results <- simulate_monthly_investment(
  monthly_combined,
  monthly_contribution = 500
)
head(monthly_investment_results)
tail(monthly_investment_results)
```
# Monthly Investment Comparison
```{r}
monthly_investment_summary <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),
  Total_Invested = rep(
    tail(monthly_investment_results$Total_Invested, 1),
    3
  ),
  Final_Value = c(
    tail(monthly_investment_results$Bitcoin_Value, 1),
    tail(monthly_investment_results$SP500_Value, 1),
    tail(monthly_investment_results$IEF_Value, 1)
  )
)
monthly_investment_summary$Gain_Loss <-
  monthly_investment_summary$Final_Value - monthly_investment_summary$Total_Invested

monthly_investment_summary$Total_Return <-
  monthly_investment_summary$Gain_Loss /monthly_investment_summary$Total_Invested

print(monthly_investment_summary)
```

# save datasets
```{r}
dir.create("Output", showWarnings = FALSE)
save(
  monthly_returns,
  monthly_volatility,
  cumulative_returns,
  lump_sum_results,
  performance_summary,
  final_investment_values,
  monthly_investment_results,
  monthly_investment_summary,
  file = "Output/processed_data.RData"
)
```
